Alleged Narco Kingpin Navpreet Singh Extradited from Turkey to India

Alleged narco kingpin Navpreet Singh has been extradited from Turkey to India. Singh had reportedly obtained Turkish citizenship under the fake name Navab Virk. Union Home Minister Amit Shah announced the deportation, calling it a 'historic milestone'.
